ai.summary_en: The day's threat landscape is defined by a high volume of critical vulnerabilities targeting desktop operating systems, network infrastructure, and middleware, with Microsoft ecosystems suffering extensive remote code execution and privilege escalation flaws across Office applications, browsers, and the Windows update stack. Enterprise networking equipment from vendors such as Cisco and HPE presented severe risks through unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerabilities, while cloud-native tools including HashiCorp Vault and Backstage were compromised by authentication bypasses and server-side request forgery attacks that endanger internal secrets and development pipelines. Broader threats included widespread buffer overflows and injection flaws impacting IoT routers, industrial control systems, and web applications, with multiple high-severity issues confirmed as actively exploited in the wild, highlighting an immediate requirement for comprehensive patching across diverse environments.

items.reason_en: NULL pointer dereference in RT-Labs C-OpenCANopen crashes devices during LSS configuration, disrupting real-time industrial bus communications.
items.reason_zh: RT-Labs C-OpenCANopen 中的空指针解引用漏洞会在 LSS 配置期间导致设备崩溃，中断实时工业总线通信。

items.reason_en: Write protection bypass in CANopen SDO server allows unauthorized parameter modification on connected industrial controllers, risking operational integrity.
items.reason_zh: CANopen SDO 服务器中的写保护绕过漏洞允许在未授权情况下修改已连接工业控制器的参数，危及运行完整性。

items.reason_en: Authenticated SQL injection in Homer telecom observability tool passes raw queries directly to DuckDB, enabling database manipulation.
items.reason_zh: 电信可观测性工具 Homer 中存在需认证的 SQL 注入漏洞，其将原始查询直接传递给 DuckDB，从而导致数据库被操纵。

items.reason_en: Ghost CMS allows staff users to host arbitrary HTML as bookmark thumbnails, enabling stored XSS or phishing within the content management system.
items.reason_zh: Ghost CMS 允许员工用户上传任意 HTML 作为书签缩略图，从而在内容管理系统中触发存储型 XSS 或钓鱼攻击。

items.reason_en: Inadequate workspace membership checks in Plane allow unauthorized asset downloads from private projects, leading to sensitive data leakage.
items.reason_zh: Plane 的工作区成员资格检查机制不足，允许从私有项目中下载未授权的资源，导致敏感数据泄露。

items.reason_en: SQL injection in the HospitalManagementSystem transaction endpoint allows attackers to manipulate or extract sensitive healthcare records.
items.reason_zh: HospitalManagementSystem 的事务端点存在 SQL 注入漏洞，允许攻击者操纵或提取敏感的医疗记录。

items.reason_en: Incomplete IP validation fix for Plane webhooks enables DNS rebinding attacks to bypass intended network restrictions.
items.reason_zh: Plane Webhook 的 IP 验证修复不完整，导致攻击者可通过 DNS 重绑定攻击绕过预期的网络限制。

items.reason_en: Case-sensitive extension blacklisting bypass in Kunstmaan CMS allows attackers to upload and execute malicious scripts disguised with mixed-case extensions.
items.reason_zh: Kunstmaan CMS 中基于大小写的扩展名黑名单存在绕过漏洞，允许攻击者上传并执行伪装成混合大小写扩展名的恶意脚本。

items.reason_en: Server-side request forgery in feelcrm-os via URL parameter manipulation allows attackers to probe internal networks and exfiltrate data.
items.reason_zh: feelcrm-os 中存在通过篡改 URL 参数触发的服务端请求伪造（SSRF）漏洞，允许攻击者探测内部网络并外泄数据。

items.reason_en: SQL injection in the food-waste-management-system registration page allows attackers to manipulate user accounts or extract database contents.
items.reason_zh: food-waste-management-system 注册页面存在 SQL 注入漏洞，允许攻击者操纵用户账户或提取数据库内容。

items.reason_en: Blind SQL injection in Gopiplus WordPress post-title-marquee-scroll plugin allows hidden database extraction without direct output.
items.reason_zh: Gopiplus WordPress post-title-marquee-scroll 插件存在盲 SQL 注入漏洞，可在无直接输出的情况下隐蔽地提取数据库内容。

items.reason_en: Blind SQL injection in AF themes WP Post Author plugin enables unauthorized database queries and data exfiltration from WordPress sites.
items.reason_zh: AF themes WP Post Author 插件存在盲 SQL 注入漏洞，可导致对 WordPress 站点的未授权数据库查询及数据外泄。

items.reason_en: Reflected XSS in Everest Forms WordPress plugin allows attackers to inject malicious scripts into victim browsers via crafted URLs.
items.reason_zh: Everest Forms WordPress 插件存在反射型跨站脚本（XSS）漏洞，允许攻击者通过构造的 URL 向受害者浏览器注入恶意脚本。

items.reason_en: Reflected XSS in Fontsplugin WordPress site enables script injection through manipulated font-related parameters in web pages.
items.reason_zh: Fontsplugin WordPress 站点存在反射型跨站脚本（XSS）漏洞，攻击者可通过篡改网页中的字体相关参数实现脚本注入。

items.reason_en: Missing authorization check in WPMU DEV Forminator allows unauthorized users to exploit misconfigured access controls and perform restricted actions.
items.reason_zh: WPMU DEV Forminator 缺失授权检查，允许未授权用户利用配置错误的访问控制执行受限操作。

items.reason_en: Weak project invitation controls in Plane allow unauthorized users to join private workspaces or accept invitations using only an email address.
items.reason_zh: Plane 的项目邀请控制机制薄弱，允许未授权用户仅凭电子邮件地址加入私有工作区或接受邀请。

items.reason_en: Drupal core SQL injection allows unauthenticated attackers to extract database contents or modify application logic, actively exploited in the wild.
items.reason_zh: Drupal core 存在 SQL 注入漏洞，允许未认证的攻击者提取数据库内容或修改应用逻辑，该漏洞已在野外被积极利用。

items.reason_en: WordPress REST API route confusion combined with SQL injection enables unauthenticated remote code execution on millions of widely deployed sites.
items.reason_zh: WordPress REST API 的路由混淆与 SQL 注入相结合，可在数百万广泛部署的站点上实现未认证的远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Joomla Page Builder CK extension unauthenticated file upload vulnerability allows direct web shell deployment and full site takeover.
items.reason_zh: Joomla Page Builder CK 扩展存在未认证的文件上传漏洞，允许直接部署 Webshell 并完全接管站点。

items.reason_en: Meta React Server Components unsafe deserialization enables pre-authentication remote code execution in modern frontend and edge architectures.
items.reason_zh: Meta React Server Components 的不安全反序列化漏洞可在现代前端和边缘架构中实现认证前的远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: SSRF in GitHub Enterprise Server enables repository contributors to pivot to internal hosts and potentially achieve remote code execution on the appliance.
items.reason_zh: GitHub Enterprise Server 存在 SSRF 漏洞，允许仓库贡献者以内部主机为跳板进行横向移动，并可能在设备上实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Stored XSS in Kiteworks Core allows authenticated users to inject malicious scripts into shared documents, compromising viewer sessions and session hijacking.
items.reason_zh: Kiteworks Core 存在存储型跨站脚本（XSS）漏洞，允许已认证用户将恶意脚本注入共享文档，从而破坏查看者会话并实施会话劫持。

items.reason_en: Default empty JWT secret in Sipcapture Homer bypasses authentication on default installations, exposing sensitive telecom observability and monitoring data.
items.reason_zh: Sipcapture Homer 在默认安装下使用空的 JWT 密钥，导致身份验证被绕过，暴露敏感的电信可观测性与监控数据。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8; Missing authorization in SharePoint enables network-based code execution via unauthenticated web requests.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 8.8；SharePoint 缺失授权检查，允许通过未认证的 Web 请求实现基于网络的代码执行。

items.reason_en: CVSS 7.3 cross-site scripting in Microsoft Office SharePoint enables network-based spoofing and potential credential harvesting.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 7.3；Microsoft Office SharePoint 存在跨站脚本（XSS）漏洞，可实现基于网络的欺骗及潜在的凭证窃取。

items.reason_en: CVSS 7.3 cross-site scripting in Microsoft Office SharePoint allows attackers to perform spoofing attacks against collaborative web applications.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 7.3；Microsoft Office SharePoint 存在跨站脚本（XSS）漏洞，允许攻击者针对协作式 Web 应用实施欺骗攻击。

items.reason_en: CVSS 7.0 use-after-free in Windows Web Platform Storage permits local privilege escalation, affecting cloud-synced storage synchronization services.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 7.0；Windows Web Platform Storage 存在释放后使用（UAF）漏洞，可导致本地权限提升，影响云同步存储服务。

items.reason_en: Heap buffer overflow in Microsoft Edge enables remote code execution, representing a high-value target for browser exploitation campaigns.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Edge 存在堆缓冲区溢出漏洞，可导致远程代码执行，使其成为浏览器利用攻击的高价值目标。

items.reason_en: Server-side request forgery (SSRF) in Visual Studio Code allows attackers to bypass security controls and access internal resources.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code 存在服务端请求伪造（SSRF）漏洞，允许攻击者绕过安全控制并访问内部资源。

items.reason_en: HTTP request/response smuggling in Visual Studio Code facilitates security feature bypasses through protocol interpretation conflicts.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code 存在 HTTP 请求/响应走私漏洞，可通过协议解释冲突绕过安全功能。

items.reason_en: Sandbox escape in IBM Langflow allows arbitrary code execution via improper input neutralization, critical for securing modern AI/LLM application frameworks deployed as web services.
items.reason_zh: IBM Langflow 存在沙箱逃逸漏洞，因输入净化不当可导致任意代码执行，这对保护以 Web 服务形式部署的现代 AI/LLM 应用框架至关重要。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in Exchange Server enables network spoofing and session hijacking, exploiting widely used web-accessible email interfaces to compromise end-users.
items.reason_zh: Exchange Server 存在跨站脚本（XSS）漏洞，可利用广泛使用的 Web 邮件接口实施网络欺骗与会话劫持，从而危及终端用户。

items.reason_en: SQL injection in SharePoint allows network privilege escalation, compromising enterprise content management platforms and enabling unauthorized data extraction or modification.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 存在 SQL 注入漏洞，可导致基于网络的权限提升，危及企业内容管理平台并允许未授权的数据提取或修改。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.5 improper control of code generation in IBM Langflow allows authenticated remote attackers to execute arbitrary code, endangering AI workflow and web application deployments.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 8.5；IBM Langflow 的代码生成控制不当漏洞允许已认证的远程攻击者执行任意代码，危及 AI 工作流与 Web 应用部署。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft JScript allows remote code execution via malicious web pages, targeting browser-dependent enterprise environments.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft JScript 存在基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，可通过恶意网页实现远程代码执行，主要威胁依赖浏览器的企业环境。

items.reason_en: A race condition in Microsoft Edge enables local privilege escalation by exploiting concurrent resource access in the Chromium-based browser engine.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Edge 存在竞态条件漏洞，通过利用基于 Chromium 的浏览器引擎中的并发资源访问，可实现本地权限提升。

items.reason_en: External control of file paths in Skype for Business permits unauthenticated remote code execution through manipulated network requests and payloads.
items.reason_zh: Skype for Business 中的文件路径外部控制漏洞允许通过操纵网络请求和有效载荷实现未认证的远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Actively exploited vulnerability in Zammad allows local privilege escalation to root, impacting widespread ticketing deployments.
items.reason_zh: Zammad 中正在被利用的漏洞允许本地权限提升至 root，影响广泛的工单系统部署。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated arbitrary file access vulnerability affects multiple Atlassian Data Center products, exposing sensitive configuration data.
items.reason_zh: 未认证的任意文件访问漏洞影响多个 Atlassian Data Center 产品，导致敏感配置数据泄露。

items.reason_en: Foreman templating engine sandbox bypass enables authenticated low-privilege users to achieve remote code execution.
items.reason_zh: Foreman 模板引擎沙箱绕过漏洞使已认证的低权限用户能够实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: A Kotlin DSL sandbox escape in JetBrains TeamCity allows attackers to bypass security restrictions and achieve remote code execution on the CI/CD server.
items.reason_zh: JetBrains TeamCity 中的 Kotlin DSL 沙箱逃逸漏洞允许攻击者绕过安全限制并在 CI/CD 服务器上实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Authenticated remote code execution in Craft CMS enables attackers with basic panel access to manipulate internal classes and execute arbitrary code on the web server.
items.reason_zh: Craft CMS 中的已认证远程代码执行漏洞使具备基础面板访问权限的攻击者能够操纵内部类并在 Web 服务器上执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Critical command injection in Progress Software's REST Connector allows attackers to execute arbitrary host commands via malicious OpenAPI documents, threatening developer workstations and APIs.
items.reason_zh: Progress Software 的 REST Connector 存在严重命令注入漏洞，攻击者可通过恶意 OpenAPI 文档执行任意主机命令，威胁开发人员工作站与 API 接口。

items.reason_en: Memory allocation and algorithmic complexity flaws in Apache Thrift framework risk denial of service or remote code execution in distributed backend services.
items.reason_zh: Apache Thrift 框架中的内存分配与算法复杂度缺陷可能导致分布式后端服务发生拒绝服务或远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Resource leak in Apache Thrift Java bindings threatens long-running backend service stability and availability.
items.reason_zh: Apache Thrift Java 绑定库的资源泄漏问题威胁长期运行的后端服务的稳定性与可用性。

items.reason_en: Undertow connection handling flaw causes memory leaks and crashes under rapid HTTP client connect/disconnect patterns.
items.reason_zh: Undertow 连接处理缺陷在 HTTP 客户端快速连接/断开场景下会导致内存泄漏与崩溃。

items.reason_en: AsyncHttpClient cross-host request replay leaves proxy context pointing to original targets, enabling SSRF and unauthorized internal network access.
items.reason_zh: AsyncHttpClient 跨主机请求重放漏洞导致代理上下文仍指向原始目标，从而引发 SSRF 及未授权的内部网络访问。

items.reason_en: Connection pooling exclusion of authenticated principals allows credential reuse across different users and potential authorization bypass.
items.reason_zh: 连接池未排除已认证主体导致不同用户间凭证复用及潜在的权限绕过。

items.reason_en: Skipped mutual-authentication verification for Digest qop=auth-int enables man-in-the-middle attacks and credential interception.
items.reason_zh: Digest qop=auth-int 跳过双向认证验证，导致中间人攻击与凭证拦截风险。

items.reason_en: Incorrect proxy tunnel inference based on last request method rather than CONNECT result enables unauthorized proxy abuse.
items.reason_zh: 基于最后一次请求方法而非 CONNECT 结果错误推断代理隧道，导致未授权的代理滥用。

items.reason_en: Digest-to-Basic challenge misclassification allows malicious proxies to downgrade authentication security and intercept credentials.
items.reason_zh: Digest 到 Basic 的挑战响应误分类使恶意代理能够降级认证安全性并拦截凭证。

items.reason_en: Omitted identity fields in connection pooling partitioning leads to session fixation and cross-user authentication leaks.
items.reason_zh: 连接池分区中遗漏的身份字段导致会话固定与跨用户认证信息泄露。

items.reason_en: Unbounded WebSocket decompression in AsyncHttpClient enables memory exhaustion and denial of service attacks against Java applications.
items.reason_zh: AsyncHttpClient 中无限制的 WebSocket 解压缩可导致内存耗尽，并对 Java 应用发起拒绝服务攻击。

items.reason_en: Session fixation and reuse across users in Apache Jackrabbit allows unauthorized access to cached authenticated sessions without credential checks.
items.reason_zh: Apache Jackrabbit 中的会话固定与跨用户会话复用漏洞，允许在未进行凭证校验的情况下未授权访问已缓存的已认证会话。

items.reason_en: Plaintext buffer handling during StartTLS negotiation in 389-ds-base enables on-path injection of crafted LDAP messages post-upgrade.
items.reason_zh: 389-ds-base 在 StartTLS 协商期间对明文缓冲区的不当处理，使得升级后能够实施路径中间注入伪造的 LDAP 消息。

items.reason_en: Heap buffer overflow in Cyrus SASL DIGEST-MD5 challenge computation allows remote code execution during authentication processes.
items.reason_zh: Cyrus SASL DIGEST-MD5 挑战计算过程中的堆缓冲区溢出漏洞，允许在认证过程中实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: XStream deserialization flaw allows remote attackers to load and execute arbitrary code by manipulating processed XML input streams.
items.reason_zh: XStream 反序列化缺陷允许远程攻击者通过操纵处理的 XML 输入流加载并执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Exposed pprof debug endpoints in postgres-exporter enable information disclosure and potential remote code execution on unauthenticated metrics listeners.
items.reason_zh: postgres-exporter 暴露的 pprof 调试端点可导致信息泄露，并使未认证的指标监听器面临潜在的远程代码执行风险。

items.reason_en: XStream remote code execution via manipulated input stream exploitation occurs when using default Java runtime configurations.
items.reason_zh: 在使用默认 Java 运行时配置时，XStream 可通过操纵输入流实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: XStream arbitrary code execution is possible through crafted XML input stream manipulation targeting default deserialization handlers.
items.reason_zh: 针对默认反序列化处理器操纵构造的 XML 输入流可导致 XStream 任意代码执行。

items.reason_en: XStream remote code execution vulnerability stems from unsafe object deserialization in processed input streams.
items.reason_zh: XStream 远程代码执行漏洞源于处理输入流时的不安全对象反序列化。

items.reason_en: XStream command execution via manipulated input stream allows attackers with sufficient rights to run host commands.
items.reason_zh: 通过操纵输入流，XStream 允许具备足够权限的攻击者执行主机命令。

items.reason_en: XStream remote code execution via manipulated input stream exploitation occurs in default Java runtime environments.
items.reason_zh: 在默认 Java 运行环境中，XStream 可通过操纵输入流实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: XStream internal resource access vulnerability allows attackers to request non-public data through crafted input stream manipulation.
items.reason_zh: XStream 内部资源访问漏洞允许攻击者通过操纵构造的输入流请求非公开数据。

items.reason_en: XStream unauthorized internal resource access via manipulated input stream specifically targets Java runtime versions 14 to 8.
items.reason_zh: XStream 通过操纵输入流未授权访问内部资源的漏洞专门针对 Java 运行时版本 8 至 14。

items.reason_en: XStream arbitrary code execution is possible through unsafe deserialization of manipulated input streams.
items.reason_zh: 对操纵的输入流进行不安全的反序列化可导致 XStream 任意代码执行。

items.reason_en: XStream remote code execution via manipulated input stream exploitation affects default XStream configurations.
items.reason_zh: 通过操纵输入流利用可导致 XStream 远程代码执行，影响默认 XStream 配置。

items.reason_en: XStream arbitrary code execution vulnerability occurs through crafted XML input stream manipulation.
items.reason_zh: 通过操纵构造的 XML 输入流可触发 XStream 任意代码执行漏洞。

items.reason_en: XStream remote code execution is possible via unsafe deserialization of manipulated input streams.
items.reason_zh: 对操纵后的输入流进行不安全反序列化可导致 XStream 远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: XStream arbitrary code execution vulnerability stems from manipulated input stream exploitation in default setups.
items.reason_zh: 在默认配置下利用操纵后的输入流可触发 XStream 任意代码执行漏洞。

items.reason_en: Infinite loop vulnerability during XLS import in Progress Telerik causes CPU exhaustion and denial of service in document processing applications.
items.reason_zh: Progress Telerik 在处理 XLS 导入时存在无限循环漏洞，可导致文档处理应用 CPU 耗尽及拒绝服务。

items.reason_en: XStream remote code execution via manipulated input stream allows shell command execution when relying solely on blocklists.
items.reason_zh: 当仅依赖黑名单时，利用操纵后的输入流可实现 XStream 远程代码执行并运行 Shell 命令。

items.reason_en: XStream denial of service vulnerability allows attackers to consume 100% CPU resources through crafted parallel execution payloads.
items.reason_zh: XStream 拒绝服务漏洞允许攻击者通过构造的并行执行负载耗尽 100% CPU 资源。

items.reason_en: Adobe ColdFusion path traversal allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code by escaping restricted directory boundaries.
items.reason_zh: Adobe ColdFusion 路径遍历漏洞允许未授权攻击者通过突破受限目录边界执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Metabase custom GeoJSON map support lacks URL validation, enabling local file inclusion and environment variable exfiltration from analytics dashboards.
items.reason_zh: Metabase 自定义 GeoJSON 地图支持缺少 URL 验证，可导致从分析仪表板发起本地文件包含及环境变量泄露。

items.reason_en: SolarWinds Web Help Desk untrusted data deserialization vulnerability permits unauthenticated remote code execution on IT service management servers.
items.reason_zh: SolarWinds Web Help Desk 不受信任数据反序列化漏洞允许在未认证情况下于 IT 服务管理服务器上执行远程代码。

items.reason_en: Improper authorization in Azure Database for PostgreSQL allows privilege escalation, directly threatening managed relational data store security.
items.reason_zh: Azure Database for PostgreSQL 存在授权不当漏洞，可导致权限提升，直接威胁托管关系型数据存储的安全。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication on LMCache management endpoints exposes environment credentials and configuration to remote attackers, impacting LLM runtime security.
items.reason_zh: LMCache 管理端点缺失身份验证机制，会向远程攻击者暴露环境凭据与配置，影响大语言模型（LLM）运行时安全。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in HDF5 library processing crafted scientific datasets can lead to application crashes or arbitrary code execution in data-intensive workflows.
items.reason_zh: HDF5 库在处理构造的科学数据集时存在堆溢出漏洞，可能导致数据密集型工作流中应用程序崩溃或任意代码执行。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8; Heap overflow in SQL Server enables network-based code execution by authenticated users.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 8.8；SQL Server 堆溢出漏洞允许已认证用户通过网络执行代码。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8; SQL injection in SQL Server allows network-based privilege escalation through crafted queries.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 8.8；SQL Server 存在 SQL 注入漏洞，攻击者可利用构造的查询语句通过网络实现权限提升。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8; Heap overflow in SQL Server enables network-based code execution via memory corruption.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 8.8；SQL Server 堆溢出漏洞可通过内存破坏实现基于网络的代码执行。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8; Integer overflow in SQL Server facilitates network-based code execution through arithmetic flaws.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 8.8；SQL Server 整数溢出漏洞可利用算术缺陷实现基于网络的代码执行。

items.reason_en: CVSS 7.0; Use-after-free in SQL Server allows local privilege escalation by authorized users.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 7.0；SQL Server 存在释放后使用漏洞，允许授权用户进行本地权限提升。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8; Improper access control in SQL Server enables network-based privilege escalation.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 8.8；SQL Server 访问控制不当漏洞可实现基于网络的权限提升。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8; Deserialization flaw in SQL Server allows network-based code execution via unsafe object handling.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 8.8；SQL Server 反序列化缺陷漏洞可通过不安全的对象处理实现基于网络的代码执行。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8; Weak authentication in SQL Server enables network-based privilege escalation.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 8.8；SQL Server 身份验证薄弱漏洞可实现基于网络的权限提升。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8; Insufficient access control granularity in SQL Server allows network-based privilege escalation.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 8.8；SQL Server 访问控制粒度不足漏洞可实现基于网络的权限提升。

items.reason_en: CVSS 7.5; External file path control in .NET allows network-based privilege escalation via path traversal.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 7.5；.NET 外部文件路径控制不当漏洞可通过路径遍历实现基于网络的权限提升。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.1 insecure deserialization in SQL Server allows remote code execution, directly compromising enterprise database servers.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 8.1；SQL Server 不安全反序列化漏洞可导致远程代码执行，直接危及企业数据库服务器安全。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 heap overflow in Microsoft WDAC OLE DB provider for SQL enables remote code execution via standard database connections.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 8.8；Microsoft WDAC OLE DB provider for SQL 堆溢出漏洞可通过标准数据库连接实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: SQL injection in Microsoft SQL Server allows authorized attackers to elevate privileges and manipulate database contents over a network.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft SQL Server 存在 SQL 注入漏洞，允许攻击者通过网络提升权限并篡改数据库内容。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the SQL Server engine enables remote code execution, risking full database server compromise.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 引擎存在基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，可导致远程代码执行，面临数据库服务器被完全攻陷的风险。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in SQL Server enables network RCE, threatening core database integrity, availability, and sensitive data confidentiality.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 堆溢出漏洞可导致基于网络的远程代码执行（RCE），严重威胁核心数据库的完整性、可用性及相关敏感数据的机密性。

items.reason_en: Injection flaw in SQL Server leads to network privilege escalation, allowing attackers to bypass security boundaries and gain administrative control over database instances.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 存在注入缺陷，可导致基于网络的权限提升，使攻击者能够绕过安全边界并获取数据库实例的管理员权限。

items.reason_en: Missing authorization in Microsoft Exchange Server allows network privilege escalation, breaking core email server security controls and enabling unauthorized administrative actions.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Exchange Server 存在授权缺失漏洞，可导致基于网络的权限提升，破坏邮件服务器的核心安全控制机制，并允许执行未授权的管理操作。

items.reason_en: Code injection in Dynamics 365 enables network RCE, directly impacting enterprise ERP and CRM deployments where trusted users execute business-critical operations.
items.reason_zh: Dynamics 365 中的代码注入漏洞可引发网络远程代码执行（RCE），直接影响企业 ERP 与 CRM 部署，此类部署中受信任用户需执行关键业务操作。

items.reason_en: A heap overflow in SQL Server allows unauthenticated remote code execution, directly threatening database availability, confidentiality, and integrity.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中的堆溢出漏洞可导致未授权远程代码执行，直接威胁数据库的可用性、机密性与完整性。

items.reason_en: SQL injection in SQL Server enables authorized users to escalate privileges and extract sensitive data from underlying enterprise systems.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中的 SQL 注入漏洞可使已授权用户提权，并从底层企业系统中窃取敏感数据。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in Active Directory Domain Services risks domain controller compromise, potentially granting attackers full network administrative dominance.
items.reason_zh: Active Directory Domain Services 中的堆溢出漏洞存在域控制器沦陷风险，可能使攻击者获得完整的网络管理控制权。

items.reason_en: Weak authorization in Microsoft Exchange Server allows authenticated attackers to elevate privileges and access mailboxes.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Exchange Server 中的授权机制缺陷可使已认证攻击者提权并访问邮箱。

items.reason_en: Apache Commons BCEL caches attacker-controlled classes under self-declared names, enabling classpath poisoning and arbitrary code execution.
items.reason_zh: Apache Commons BCEL 会在自定义名称下缓存攻击者可控的类，从而导致类路径污染及任意代码执行。

items.reason_en: Integer wraparound in the pgvector extension causes out-of-bounds memory writes during index builds, potentially allowing arbitrary code execution in PostgreSQL databases on 32-bit systems.
items.reason_zh: pgvector 扩展中的整数回绕问题在构建索引时会引发越界内存写入，可能导致 32 位系统上的 PostgreSQL 数据库发生任意代码执行。

items.reason_en: Null pointer dereference during Excelize parsing can crash applications processing user-uploaded spreadsheets or trigger unexpected behavior.
items.reason_zh: Excelize 解析过程中的空指针解引用可导致处理用户上传电子表格的应用程序崩溃或引发异常行为。

items.reason_en: Missing bounds validation on Excel column ranges may cause memory corruption or application crashes when processing malicious XLSX files.
items.reason_zh: 缺乏对 Excel 列范围的边界验证，在处理恶意 XLSX 文件时可能导致内存破坏或应用程序崩溃。

items.reason_en: Golang RSA memory leak can be triggered by attackers to cause resource exhaustion and denial of service in cryptographic operations.
items.reason_zh: Golang RSA 内存泄漏可被攻击者触发，导致加密操作中的资源耗尽与服务拒绝（DoS）。

items.reason_en: Direct application of Unix permission bits during ZIP extraction can lead to privilege escalation or unauthorized file modifications.
items.reason_zh: ZIP 解压过程中直接应用 Unix 权限位可能导致权限提升或未授权的文件篡改。

items.reason_en: Malformed client registration data in Absolute Security servers triggers persistent denial of service, disrupting secure access availability.
items.reason_zh: Absolute Security 服务器中接收畸形客户端注册数据会触发持续性拒绝服务攻击，影响安全访问的可用性。

items.reason_en: Authentication subsystem flaw in Absolute Security enables persistent denial of service through malformed responses, impacting secure access reliability.
items.reason_zh: Absolute Security 的身份验证子系统缺陷可通过畸形响应触发持续性拒绝服务攻击，影响安全访问的可靠性。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated traffic targeting connection setup in Absolute Security causes persistent denial of service, disrupting VPN and access gateway operations.
items.reason_zh: 针对 Absolute Security 连接建立过程的未认证流量会引发持续性拒绝服务攻击，干扰 VPN 与访问网关的运行。

items.reason_en: Insufficient validation during Excelize decryption dispatch allows attacker-controlled values to trigger memory corruption or application crashes.
items.reason_zh: Excelize 解密分发过程中的验证不足，会使攻击者可控的值触发内存破坏或应用程序崩溃。

items.reason_en: Acceptance of attacker-controlled spinCount in Excelize agile decryption enables CPU exhaustion and denial of service attacks.
items.reason_zh: Excelize 敏捷解密过程接受攻击者可控的 spinCount 参数，可导致 CPU 耗尽及拒绝服务攻击。

items.reason_en: Critical OIDC authentication bypass in SimpleHelp accepts unsigned tokens, enabling full administrative takeover of remote support systems.
items.reason_zh: SimpleHelp 中存在严重的 OIDC 身份验证绕过漏洞，该漏洞接受未签名令牌，致使攻击者可完全接管远程支持系统。

items.reason_en: Missing bounds checks on Excelize pivot-table indices can trigger out-of-bounds reads and application crashes during parsing.
items.reason_zh: Excelize 解析过程中若缺失对数据透视表索引的边界检查，将触发越界读取并导致应用程序崩溃。

items.reason_en: Recursive calculation bypass in Excelize ANCHORARRAY defeats iteration controls, potentially causing CPU exhaustion or stack overflow.
items.reason_zh: Excelize 中 ANCHORARRAY 的递归计算绕过机制破坏了迭代控制，可能导致 CPU 耗尽或栈溢出。

items.reason_en: Hydra logging configuration bypass allows attackers to manipulate handler classes, potentially leading to information disclosure or log injection.
items.reason_zh: Hydra 日志配置绕过漏洞允许攻击者操控处理器类，可能导致信息泄露或日志注入。

items.reason_en: LMCache unauthenticated remote code execution via exposed /run_script endpoint allows attackers to execute arbitrary Python code in AI inference clusters.
items.reason_zh: LMCache 通过暴露的 /run_script 端点存在未授权远程代码执行漏洞，攻击者可在 AI 推理集群中执行任意 Python 代码。

items.reason_en: Manacle Technologies ERP unsafe deserialization of user-controlled data enables unauthenticated remote code execution in business management systems.
items.reason_zh: Manacle Technologies ERP 对用户可控数据进行不安全的反序列化，导致业务管理系统中存在未授权远程代码执行漏洞。

items.reason_en: PraisonAI code injection via f-string interpolation in deploy/api.py allows attackers to execute arbitrary server-side scripts in multi-agent automation workflows.
items.reason_zh: PraisonAI 的 deploy/api.py 中存在基于 f-string 插值的代码注入漏洞，攻击者可在多智能体自动化工作流中执行任意服务端脚本。

items.reason_en: Dependency confusion in IBM Langflow OSS enables remote code execution during package resolution, severely impacting AI development pipeline supply chains.
items.reason_zh: IBM Langflow 开源项目中的依赖混淆漏洞可在软件包解析阶段引发远程代码执行，严重破坏 AI 开发流水线供应链。

items.reason_en: Improper input validation in Backstage Sentry scaffolder actions allows authenticated users to trigger unintended backend behavior in developer portals.
items.reason_zh: Backstage Sentry 脚手架操作中的输入验证缺陷，可使已认证用户在开发者门户中触发非预期的后端行为。

items.reason_en: Key flag inference flaw in Red Hat sequoia-openpgp allows back-signature check bypasses, undermining OpenPGP cryptographic trust models and email/document signing.
items.reason_zh: Red Hat sequoia-openpgp 中的密钥标志推断缺陷可导致逆向签名检查被绕过，削弱 OpenPGP 密码学信任模型及邮件/文档签名机制的安全性。

items.reason_en: CVSS 7.7 improper input validation in AMD ROCm RCCL library allows peer ranks or network-adjacent attackers to achieve remote code execution in AI/HPC workloads.
items.reason_zh: AMD ROCm RCCL 库中存在 CVSS 评分为 7.7 的输入验证缺陷，允许对等节点或网络邻近攻击者在 AI/HPC 工作负载中实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Improper access control in IBM Langflow allows remote authenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code in AI workflow deployments.
items.reason_zh: IBM Langflow 中的访问控制缺陷允许远程已认证攻击者在 AI 工作流部署中执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in Active Directory Certificate Services permits local privilege escalation, threatening enterprise PKI infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Active Directory Certificate Services 中的堆溢出漏洞可导致本地权限提升，威胁企业 PKI 基础设施的安全。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in Active Directory Domain Services enables network-based code execution, risking core directory authentication.
items.reason_zh: Active Directory Domain Services 中的释放后使用（Use-after-Free）漏洞可支持基于网络的代码执行，危及核心目录的身份验证机制。

items.reason_en: Improper code generation control in IBM Langflow allows authenticated remote attackers to execute arbitrary commands within AI development and workflow frameworks.
items.reason_zh: IBM Langflow 中存在代码生成控制不当漏洞，允许经过身份验证的远程攻击者在 AI 开发与工作流框架内执行任意命令。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Visual Studio enables unauthenticated remote code execution during development, testing, and debugging sessions.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可在开发、测试和调试会话期间导致未经身份验证的远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: llama.cpp contains a use-after-free and double free vulnerability in the chat parser that allows unauthenticated remote heap corruption.
items.reason_zh: llama.cpp 的聊天解析器中存在释放后使用与双重释放漏洞，可导致未经身份验证的远程堆损坏。

items.reason_en: StableLib CBOR decoder lacks maximum nesting depth enforcement, causing stack exhaustion and denial of service in JavaScript environments.
items.reason_zh: StableLib 的 CBOR 解码器缺乏最大嵌套深度限制，会导致 JavaScript 环境中出现栈耗尽与拒绝服务。

items.reason_en: An integer overflow in libarchive triggers a double-free condition, risking memory corruption and arbitrary code execution in applications utilizing this widely-used compression library.
items.reason_zh: libarchive 中的整数溢出会触发双重释放条件，可能导致使用该广泛应用的压缩库的程序发生内存损坏和任意代码执行。
